messages:
sre-bot: ALERT: streaming-api /v1/stream p99 latency > 2s for last 5m. SLO breach warning. auto-paging oncall aisha. :rotating_light:

Aisha (oncall): I'm on it. seeing alert, pulling up traces and recent rollout events. any deploys in last 30m?

deploy-bot: Recent deploys: runtime/serve v3.12.4 at 1769999400 by mark (runtime). No rollbacks.

Mark (runtime): that deploy was a small kernel flag tweak for CUDA driver heuristic. didn't touch batching. rolling it back now as a quick mitigation plan.

Aisha (oncall): good. metrics: p95 ~ 450ms, p99 ~ 2.6s, streaming stalls count spiked from ~30/min to 250/min. tail latency correlated with shared-gpu pool IOwait.

Vikram (eng-sre): seeing elevated iowait on node-gpu-17 and kernel logs with NVMe queue stalls. cgroups for tenant-101 are at high blktrace rates. noisy neighbor suspected.

Jess (prodops): which customers impacted? any enterprise tenants reporting errors?

Aisha (oncall): initial customer impact: 4 high-volume tenants showed streaming stalls and 503s for chunked responses. overall error rate up 0.8% above baseline. contacting CSM to notify enterprise customers.

Mark (runtime): rollback in progress: initiating rollback to v3.12.3 and restarting runtime pods on nodes 15-18. command I ran:

```
# rollback and restart
kubectl set image deploy/runtime runtime=registry/redwood/runtime:v3.12.3 -n prod
kubectl rollout restart deploy/runtime -n prod
```

Vikram (eng-sre): while rollback runs, recommend live mitigation: 1) move affected tenants off shared-gpu pool to dedicated-burst pool, 2) apply temporary blkio throttle to tenant cgroup, 3) enable IO read-ahead tuning. I can push tenant moves if we approve.

Aisha (oncall): do it. priority: reduce p99 asap. who can execute tenant migration?

Jess (prodops): I can trigger migration for the four customers. plan: reassign k8s nodeAffinity to dedicated-burst nodegroup and scale up replicas. this will incur small cold-starts but avoids stalls. doing tenant-101 first.

Vikram (eng-sre): applying temporary blkio limit to tenant-101 cgroup:

```
echo 10485760 > /sys/fs/cgroup/blkio/docker/<container-id>/blkio.throttle.read_bps_device
```

Vikram (eng-sre): also adjusting cgroup cpu.shares for noisy tenant down from 2048 to 512 to reduce scheduler dominance.

Aisha (oncall): rollback completed on some pods, but p99 only dropped to ~1.5s. migration of tenant-101 started; I see requests routing to dedicated-burst nodes.

Mark (runtime): confirming kernel flags toggled back. we didn't change NV drivers; rollback removed our heuristic change. kernel logs show fewer NVMe stalls but still present on node-17.

Jess (prodops): tenant-101 migration finished. p99 dropped to 700ms for that tenant specifically. overall p99 now ~900ms. error rate trending down.

Vikram (eng-sre): digging into disk IO patterns: tenant-101 has lots of large embedding lookups and spilling to disk due to KV cache miss rate spike. spike coincided with a heavy eval run from that tenant at 1769999300. noisy neighbor confirmed.

Aisha (oncall): customer-facing summary for CSM: brief impact, mitigation steps (migrated to dedicated-burst, applied blkio throttle, rolled back runtime tweak), ETA to full resolution?

Jess (prodops): I'll draft and send. ETA: monitoring for 30m post-migration, then confirm stable.

Mark (runtime): longer-term: we need stronger autoshedding to prevent KV-spill cascades and enforce per-tenant disk IO budgets. filing tracking ticket after incident.

Vikram (eng-sre): agreed. also add improved detection: correlate trace tail spikes with node blktrace and cgroup metrics to auto-surface noisy neighbor candidates.

Aisha (oncall): declaring incident severity: SEV2 (SLO breach but partial mitigation possible). assigning postmortem owners: vikram + mark + jess. handoff to eng-sre for next shift at 1770002400.

Aisha (oncall): handoff notes: rollback done, 3 tenants migrated (101, 403, 512), blkio limits applied to 101, monitoring p99 trending down to <1s. follow-up actions: postmortem, ticket for autoshedding, customer comms (Jess).

sre-bot: Incident log updated: incident-2026-03-14-0001, severity SEV2, owner aisha, assignees vikram, mark, jess.

Mark (runtime): I'll stay on for the next 20min to verify no regressions. if anything spikes, @aisha please re-alert. :thumbsup:

Aisha (oncall): thanks team. closing slack thread and switching to incident doc. will attach metrics snapshots and heap/trace excerpts there.
